sentence: A spinning wheel that assigns each chore on a short list to one person in the chat, giving better odds to people who have been picked less often.
use_when: The group needs to decide who does which chore
Someone wants a fair random pick that favors people who have done less
A few chores need owners and nobody wants to choose
A chore needs to be re-spun after someone can't do it
dont_use_when: The group wants a recurring weekly schedule or calendar
The group needs to vote or poll on a choice
The group wants to split a bill or track money owed
